title: Interpretation policy (.noru/interpretation-policy.yml)
description: Which agents may own which claims, who answers for them, and for how long. Committed, protected by CODEOWNERS through repo-enforcement, and read from the base revision in CI, so a pull request that widens it is judged by the policy it would replace. The policy can only narrow what a piece's validator allows: an agent may only renew a claim anchored to a structure a person signed, and no grant can give it anything else.

id.description: What an agent-owned claim names in interpretation.policy_ref.

piece.description: A piece that declares interpretation.agent_owners. change-control, audit-pack and review-signoff never accept an agent owner.

claims.description: Renewals only. New claims, changed claims and drift acknowledgements are a person's.

agents.description: The identities an agent writes as interpretation.owner.

operators.description: The named people who may answer for these agents. Never a team alias.

max_days.description: How long an agent's renewal may stand, from its decided_at. At most the piece's own agent ceiling.
